decisions.title: Complete replacement release package
decisions.decision: Preserve only .git and images; replace every other deployed file.
decisions.reason: Prevents stale files and keeps non-technical deployment predictable.

decisions.title: Epic and subsystem delivery model
decisions.decision: Design releases as slices of complete epics and subsystems.
decisions.reason: Avoids local features that later require architectural rebuilds.

decisions.title: Project Brain in repository
decisions.decision: Store roadmap, architecture, backlog, decisions and release history as machine-readable project files.
decisions.reason: Makes the project resumable without relying on chat memory.

decisions.title: Readiness-aware diagnostics
decisions.decision: Health checks wait for runtime readiness and retry transient unknown states before warning.
decisions.reason: Avoids false warnings immediately after deployment or page load.
